AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION

07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Design Review No. DR-2012-26 & Variance No. V-2012-02 Applicant: Shea Homes
Location: Rosedale Tract: 66141 (Great park 1)
Assessor Parcel Numbers: 8625-035-007/008/006/005/004/003/002 & 001
Request for approval of a Design Review application requesting approval of the architectural design, layout and construction of 112 Multi-family units consisting of (7) 4-plex buildings and (21) 6-plex buildings located within the Promenade District of the Rosedale planned community. A Variance is requested as a part of this approval to allow reduced landscape planting space from the required widths. This public hearing item was continued from the 12-12-12 Planning Commission meeting.
Item F-1 Staff Report and Attachments
2.
Use Permit No. UP-2012-08 Applicant: Tim Arietta (La Tolteca Restaurant)
Location: 429 N. Azusa Avenue
Proposed Use Permit application to allow a modification to an existing Conditional Use Permit (C-2001-13) which allows the sale of beer and wine at the La Tolteca Restaurant. The modification is to additionally allow the sale of distilled spirits at the restaurant. This project is exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15061(b)(2)(3) - No possibility that the activity may have a significant effect on the environment.
